results.content:
Weight has increased, and the iPhone 18 Pro weighs 211 grams, up from 206 grams. The iPhone 18 Pro Max weighs 249 grams, up from 233 grams.

Battery capacity listed here is for eSIM-only models sold in the United States and other countries. In some locations, iPhones have a SIM tray and a slightly smaller battery.

results.title: iPhone 18 Pro Battery Capacities Revealed by Regulatory Filings - MacRumors
results.content:
According to new filings in China's C3 database, spotted by the leaker known as " Digital Chat Station" on Weibo, the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ is seemingly rated for 4,056mAh in China and 4,288mAh in the U.S., up modestly from the iPhone 17 Pro's 3,988mAh and 4,252mAh. The ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ Max shows a bigger jump, rated for 5,391mAh in China and 5,567mAh in the U.S., compared with 4,823mAh and 5,088mAh on the ‌iPhone 17‌ Pro Max, an increase of nearly 500mAh.

### iPhone 18 Pro

| | China | China Difference | U.S. | U.S. Difference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| iPhone 16 Pro | 3,582mAh | +308mAh | 3,582mAh | +308mAh |
| ‌iPhone 17‌ Pro | 3,988mAh | +406mAh | 4,252mAh | +670mAh |
| ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ | 4,056mAh | +68mAh | 4,288mAh | +36mAh |

...

The devices in the filings are not directly named the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ and ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ Max, but are highly likely to relate to these models.

The China and U.S. capacities differ because Apple has continued to include a SIM tray on iPhones sold outside the United States, while U.S. models have been eSIM only since the iPhone 14 lineup. Without a physical tray taking up internal space, Apple can fit a slightly larger battery into the U.S. version of each device.

The certification listings cover battery models S2232 and S2233 for the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ and 2235L/2235 and 2236L/2236 for the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ Max, and also show rated energy figures of up to 21.751Wh and a 4.520V charge limit voltage, and list all four batteries as valid through May or June 2031.

results.title: iPhone 18 Pro Battery Capacity: The Reported 4,288 and 5,567 mAh Figures vs Apple's Hour Ratings
results.content:
Apple rates the iPhone 18 Pro at up to 36 hours of video playback and the iPhone 18 Pro Max at up to 45 hours, and it does not publish battery capacity in milliampere-hours. Reported figures put the cells at 4,288 mAh for the 18 Pro and 5,567 mAh for the 18 Pro Max, both for the eSIM-only versions, and Apple has not confirmed either number.

...

## Key facts

| Rating | iPhone 18 Pro | iPhone 18 Pro Max | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Battery capacity | 4,288 mAh (eSIM-only model) | 5,567 mAh (eSIM-only model) | Reported; not confirmed by Apple |
| Typical use | Up to 24 hours | Up to 30 hours | Apple’s tech specs |
| Video playback | Up to 36 hours | Up to 45 hours | Apple’s tech specs (eSIM-only model) |
| Streamed video | Up to 33 hours | Up to 40 hours | Apple’s tech specs |
| Wired charging | Up to 50 percent in around 15 minutes with a 60W USB-C adapter | Same | Apple’s tech specs |
| Wireless charging | Up to 50 percent in 30 minutes with a 35W adapter plus MagSafe; MagSafe and Qi2 up to 25W | Same | Apple’s tech specs |
| Weight | 211 g | 249 g | Apple’s tech specs |

...

The 4,288 mAh and 5,567 mAh numbers come from third-party spec listings, not from Apple, and they are attached to the eSIM-only versions of each phone. That qualifier matters because Apple’s own video playback ratings carry the same note: 36 and 45 hours are quoted for the eSIM-only models sold in the United States, Canada, Japan, Mexico, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain, Guam and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
